note: The same hop-back path as the warrior's and the mage's dodge, with a little extra lift (y, in frame widths) because the Rogue's drawn hop is lower than theirs (her feet are 57 and 11 px up on frames 3 and 4, the mage's 73 and 33): 0.03 and 0.04 of a 512 px frame add about 15 and 20 px. x: character widths from the home position, negative = away from the enemy. evadeFrame: the frame on screen when the dodged strike would have landed (the peak of the hop).
